## Before you paste this link into the course

- [ ] Branch is named after the folder (`project-NN-name`) and was cut from a fresh `main`
- [ ] `pytest -q` is green inside the project folder, with no API key configured
- [ ] Every section of the README is filled in, and the file is named `README.md`
- [ ] The demo link at the top of the README opens in a private browser window (unlisted YouTube, two to three minutes, one take)
- [ ] The AI-assistance section has all three fields filled in, including what the assistant got wrong that you caught
- [ ] No `.env`, key, token or personal path is in the diff (check with `git diff main --stat` and a search for `sk-`)
- [ ] Nothing outside this project's folder changed

## What the reviewer should look at first

_One or two sentences. The decision you are least sure about, or the part you are proudest of._
